{{Top|leg}}
'''Aleron Starport''' was an [[Imperial-class spaceport|Imperial-class]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that served the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleron]]. Built on a series of metal platforms, the facility's amenities were built on the underside of the docking platform. These included [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], shopping centers, [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], maintenance facilities, and refueling stations. [[Turbolift/Legends|Turbolifts]] connected Aleron Starport to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Daekun]], which was located over one thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below the planet's surface. Due to Aleron's position on the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]], Aleron Starport was extremely busy and generated a sizable amount of income.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
